capabilities: : Render inline code in wikilink aliases
: Display bold and italic in wikilink aliases
: Show strikethrough and highlight in wikilink aliases
extras: Free core features; Pro requires GitHub sponsorship.
intentEvidence: Wikilink Alias Markup shows the Markdown markup in the alias of a wikilink.
problem: Standard wikilink aliases display markup characters (like backticks or asterisks) as plain text rather than rendering them as formatted Markdown.
summary: Displays Markdown markup like inline code, bold, and italics within the alias of a wikilink in both Live Preview and Reading view.
